SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. B. D. 7847
S.1, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date. March 23rd. 1937.

Subject. Agitation among workers of Price's Candle Factory (British),
Nos. 3 and 5 Robison Road.

Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by J Logan D S I

Price's Candle Factory, No.5 Robison Road, employs 133
hands.

At 10 a.m. March 22 seven workers of the Oil Department
approached the management and demanded a further increase of
15 cents per week over and above the recent increase from
$4.50 to $4.85 per week granted by the Company. The manager
replied that he would refer their demand to the General Manager.
Consequent upon this demand, 13 workers employed in the godown,
who formerly received the same rate of pay as the oil workers,
interviewed the manager and demanded an increase proportionate
to the demands made by the oil workers. The manager assured
them that their demand would receive due consideration. Unrest
among the workers continued, and at 2.30 p.m. March 22, the
candle packers, numbering 21, struck work as a result of the
management's refusal to entertain their demand for an increase
of 2.5 cents per 100 packages. As a result of this latest
development the management decided to cease operations, and
close the Factory.

Between 6 p.m. and 7 p.m. the same day, Mah Tsing (馬俊),
representative of the workers, residing at 1006 Tonquin Road,
and Li Kyih Ling (李吉林), a member of the Standing Committee of
the 3rd District Cotton Spinning Workers' Union, residing at 1043
Tung Yih Faung, Robison Road, together with three other workers
named Wong Tsong Chi (王忠志), Yang Ting Fah (楊定發) and Lieu
Ah Doo (劉阿度), held a meeting at the home of the first named.
The strikers were advised to resume work pending negotiations
with the management regarding the following demands:-
1. Increase of pay by 2.5 cents per 100 packages.
2. Retirement gratuity equal to one month's pay for each year of

档案编号 B. D. 7847
S.1，特别科。
报告
日期：1937年3月23日。

事由：罗宾森路（Robison Road）3号和5号英商卜内门烛皂厂（Price's Candle Factory）工人中的煽动活动。

呈报人：副督察长 Laurier 转呈人：J Logan 副督察长

罗宾森路5号卜内门烛皂厂雇用工人133名。

3月22日上午10时，油脂部的七名工人向资方提出，在公司最近将周薪从4.50元增至4.85元的基础上，再每周增加1角5分。经理答复称，他将把他们的要求转呈总经理。鉴于这一要求，以前与油脂部工人领取同等工资、受雇于货栈的13名工人也面见经理，要求按照油脂部工人所提要求的比例增加工资。经理向他们保证，他们的要求将得到适当考虑。工人中的不安情绪仍在继续，3月22日下午2时30分，由于资方拒绝接受他们提出的每包装100包增加2.5分的要求，21名装烛工人罢工。鉴于这一最新事态，资方决定停止作业，关闭工厂。

同日傍晚6时至7时之间，住在通金路（Tonquin Road）1006号的工人代表马俊（Mah Tsing），以及住在罗宾森路同益坊（Tung Yih Faung）1043号的第三区棉纺业工会常务委员李吉林（Li Kyih Ling），连同另外三名分别名为王忠志（Wong Tsong Chi）、杨定发（Yang Ting Fah）和刘阿度（Lieu Ah Doo）的工人，在第一名提及者的家中举行会议。与会者建议罢工者在就以下要求进行谈判期间复工：
1. 每包装100包增加工资2.5分。
2. 服务满三年后，每服务一年发给相当于一个月工资的退休金。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
                                Pootoo Road Station,
            REPORT              Date... March 23, 19 37.
Subject Labour unrest at Price's Candle Factory, No. 3/5 Robison Road.

Made by D.S.I. White        Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
    At about 3¹⁵ p.m. 22-3-37, a telephone communication was
received at Pootoo Road Police Station from Mr. Margerison,
Manager, Price's Candle Factory, No. 3/5 Robison Road, to the
effect that male members of the Packing Department had struck
work. Subsequent enquiries amongst the dis-satisfied employees,
numbering 20 male persons, elicited the information that they are
dis-satisfied with the recent increase granted to their particular
department by the Head Office, as other departments had received
a greater monetary increase than their particular department.
    The strikers were addressed by the Manager, who informed
them that they could either resume work, and later submit a
petition containing their demands to the Head Office for
consideration, or continue to strike, which would entail their
dismissal.
    The strikers agreed to submit their demands to the Head
Office within the next few days, whereupon they left the factory
at the usual time the factory closes for the day.
    Enquiries at the factory in the morning of the 23-3-37,
elicited the information that all the strikers had resumed work
and that the normal working conditions had been resumed.

                                    I am, Sir,
                                    Yours obediently,
                                    [Signature]
                                    D.S.I.

D.D.C. S.P.
Officer i/c, S.P.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号............
                                普陀路警署，
            报告              日期... 1937年3月23日。
事由：罗宾森路3/5号卜内门烛皂厂的劳资纠纷。

呈报人：副督察长 White        转呈人 [签名]

先生，
    1937年3月22日下午3时15分左右，普陀路警署接到罗宾森路3/5号卜内门烛皂厂经理 Margerison 先生的电话，称包装部的男性成员已罢工。随后在对20名男性不满员工进行的问询中获悉，他们对总公司最近给予其所在部门的加薪幅度不满，因为其他部门获得的货币加薪幅度高于其所在部门。
    经理对罢工者发表了讲话，告知他们要么复工，随后向总公司提交包含其要求的请愿书以供审议，要么继续罢工，这将导致他们被解雇。
    罢工者同意在接下来几天内将其要求提交总公司，随后他们在工厂通常下班的时间离开了工厂。
    1937年3月23日上午在工厂进行的问询获悉，所有罢工者均已复工，正常工作秩序已恢复。

                                    此致，
                                    您顺从的仆人，
                                    [签名]
                                    副督察长

D.D.C. S.P.
S.P. 主管警官
